I have experience teaching courses both at the bachelor and master's level at Aarhus University, Heinrich Heine University, University of Milan, and University Carlos III of Madrid.

-   Research methods (BA course, Madrid; course convenor and lecturer), 2025/2026.

-   Public Policy Evaluation (BA course, Madrid; lecturer), 2025/2026.

-   Political Analysis (BA course, Madrid; course convenor and lecturer), 2025/2026.

-   Positive Political Theory (MSc course, Milan; teaching assistant), 2024/2025.

-   Electoral Systems and Representation (BA course, HHU; course convenor and lecturer), 2024/2025.

-   [Electoral Systems: Do They Really Matter?](https://kursuskatalog.au.dk/en/course/113493/223E22-Electoral-Systems-Do-They-Really-Matter) (MA course, Aarhus; course convenor and lecturer), 2022/2023. [Syllabus](teaching/electoral_systems.pdf).

-   [Political Institutions: Western Countries, EU, and Foreign Policy](https://kursuskatalog.au.dk/en/course/110302/Political-Institutions-Western-Countries-EU-and-Foreign-Policy) (Aarhus, teaching assistant), 2021/2022
